# UiSkeleton

A placeholder shape shown while content loads.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | feedback |
| Import | `import { UiSkeleton } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiSkeleton from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiSkeleton'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/feedback/UiSkeleton.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/feedback/UiSkeleton.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `'text' \| 'rect' \| 'circle'` | `'text'` |  |
| `width` | `string` |  | CSS inline size, e.g. `12rem` or `60%`. |
| `height` | `string` |  | CSS block size. Text skeletons default to one line. |
| `lines` | `number` | `1` | Number of text lines (the last one is shorter). |
| `announce` | `boolean` | `false` | Announce a loading status. By default skeletons are decorative; mark the region being loaded with `aria-busy="true"` or announce once here. |

## Attributes

The root `<span>`.

## Accessibility

- Decorative (`aria-hidden`) by default; mark the loading region with `aria-busy`.
- `announce` renders a polite status instead.
- The shimmer stops with reduced motion.

## Styling

- `.vui-skeleton`, `.vui-skeleton__block`
- `data-shape`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/FeedbackDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/FeedbackDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex max-w-md items-start gap-3" aria-busy="true">
  <UiSkeleton shape="circle" />
  <div class="grid flex-1 gap-2">
    <UiSkeleton :lines="3" />
    <UiSkeleton shape="rect" height="3rem" />
  </div>
</div>
```
